rules.title: Void of Course Moon — Strict Traditional
rules.definition: Moon has no applying Ptolemaic aspect to a traditional planet before leaving its current sign.

source_notes.author: William Lilly
source_notes.note: Interpretation requires contextual handling; definitions vary.

rules.limitations: Not universally treated as a prohibition; depends on context and source.

rules.title: Strict solar visibility thresholds
rules.definition: Classify cazimi, combustion, under beams, and freedom from beams by absolute geocentric elongation from the Sun.

source_notes.author: Multiple traditional authors
source_notes.note: Thresholds and exceptions vary; profile values are explicit configuration.

rules.limitations: Mercury and Venus phases require additional context.

rules.title: Planetary joy
rules.definition: Planet occupies the house traditionally assigned as its joy.
rules.limitations: House-system implications and strength weighting are profile-dependent.
